spec_match.rationale: Probes the four exact surfaces the entry ships (prototype width attribute, constructor width member with read-back so ignored members cannot pass, the BindingAlias width⇄stretch contract in both directions, and @font-face font-width CSSOM read-back) plus the related font-width property, tracked separately and labelled as such.

interactive.rationale: One button executes all five probes against the live engine and fills a results table with observed values.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card lists exactly these five checks; the page runs exactly them.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the ignored-dictionary-member trap explicitly, constructor exceptions, missing .style on CSSFontFaceRule, dropped declarations, and a partial-implementation verdict branch.

references.rationale: Links CSS Font Loading FontFace interface and CSS Fonts 4 font-width; the feature index links ChromeStatus 5145402365050880.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite mirrors these probes one-to-one (attribute exists, constructor member reflects, alias binding, descriptor parses) and fails honestly on this pre-153 engine while the legacy-descriptor assertion passes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP driver run 2026-08-16 (f2-probe.png): all four loading-API rows reported 'no — absent' with observed details (width member ignored, f.stretch stayed 'normal', font-width declaration dropped) and the verdict named the pre-153 state without blaming browser age alone; zero console errors, no failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts font-width-probe-ran with the per-surface booleans so the fleet can watch the flip to 4/4 as 153 rolls out.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only; result cells pair emerald/amber borders with explicit yes/no text.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic table with scoped headers inside a keyboard-focusable scroll region, native button, role=status verdict line.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes; the probe table scrolls inside its own container at 360px.

openQuestions.title: Re-run on a Chrome 153 build to capture the 4/4 pass state
openQuestions.detail: This Chromium 141 can only demonstrate the honest all-absent state (no flag exists to pre-enable the feature — verified against runtime_enabled_features.json5). When a 153 binary is available, verify the alias-binding probe passes in both directions and the verdict switches to the full-support text.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible data table for feature detection results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use th scope row/column headers and convey pass/fail with text as well as colour.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every row header is a th scope=row; result cells read 'yes ✓' / 'no — absent' alongside the coloured border; the verdict is a role=status paragraph.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel layout without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide tables scroll inside their own overflow-x:auto region rather than the page body.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The probes table has min-inline-size 560px inside a focusable .table-wrap; the 360px viewport shows no page-level horizontal scroll (harness-verified).

summary: Five falsifiable probes of the exact Chrome 153 loading-API surfaces, each reporting observed engine behaviour. On this Chromium 141 all four new surfaces honestly report absent (with the legacy names shown working), matching the Chromium-source finding that no flag can pre-enable the change.
